    }

    public static int doses(int itemId) {
        final int[] v = VARIANTS.get(itemId);

    }

    /**
     * Every item id any recipe mentions - primaries, secondaries, outputs
     */
    private static final Set<Integer> RELEVANT_ITEM_IDS = RECIPES.stream()
            .flatMap(Recipes::getItemIdsForRecipe)
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());

    private static final Set<Integer> SEED_ITEM_IDS = RECIPES.stream()
            .filter(recipe -> recipe.getTag() == SEED)
            .map(recipe -> recipe.getPrimary().getItemId())
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());

    private Recipes() {
    }

    public static List<Recipe> all() {
        return Collections.unmodifiableList(RECIPES);
    }

    /**
     * @return the recipe growing this seed - the one whose yield the seed's setting overrides
     */
    public static int seedRecipeIdOf(int seedItemId) {
        return RECIPES.stream()
                .filter(recipe -> recipe.getTag() == SEED && recipe.getPrimary().getItemId() == seedItemId)
                .findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("no recipe grows item " + seedItemId))
                .getId();
    }

    public static boolean isSeed(int itemId) {
        return SEED_ITEM_IDS.contains(itemId);
    }

    public static boolean isRelevantItem(int itemId) {
        return RELEVANT_ITEM_IDS.contains(itemId);
    }

    private static Stream<Integer> getItemIdsForRecipe(Recipe recipe) {
        return Stream.concat(
                Stream.of(recipe.getPrimary().getItemId(), recipe.getOutput().getItemId()),
                recipe.getSecondaries().stream().map(Ingredient::getItemId));
    }
